name: holiday-has-no-blocks
description: A holiday on Wednesday leaves that day without blocks and the week with four work days.
prompt:
Plan my week. Today is Monday 2026-11-02 at 09:00. No destination, no calendar tool, no tracker. Wednesday 2026-11-04 is a public holiday. Work hours 09:00-18:00.
Tickets: ABC-7 Rewrite importer (30h).
Do not run any tool and do not save anywhere: do what the skill says to do when there is nowhere to save, and do the fitting yourself following the script's rules.
